reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getMonthWideBudgetCategories and uses the existing getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and isTrackingBudget helpers.

duplication.why: The only repetition is the per-action 'income outside tracking budgets' skip inside the loop, which every sibling action already repeats; the category selection itself is shared.

placement.why: The action sits in server/budget/actions.ts beside the other month-wide actions and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Small, consistent with its siblings, and any future change to which categories are filled reaches it through the shared selection.
